mapper.insert: insert into strategy_award_stock_confirm_task (user_id, order_id, strategy_id, award_id, reservation_id, lock_surplus, state, retry_count) values (#{userId}, #{orderId}, #{strategyId}, #{awardId}, #{reservationId}, #{lockSurplus}, #{state}, #{retryCount})
mapper.select: select user_id, order_id, strategy_id, award_id, reservation_id, lock_surplus, state, retry_count from strategy_award_stock_confirm_task where state = 'pending' order by create_time asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update strategy_award_stock_confirm_task set state = 'confirmed', update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and order_id = #{orderId} and state = 'pending'
